seg.notes: Segment revenues include freight, delivery & transportation revenues (Aggregates footnote), so seg.delivery_rev is null (not shown separately in the segment table; consolidated freight & delivery revenues are in is.delivery_rev). Only Aggregates has intersegment sales. Calcium segment = calcium products (Florida). Asphalt/Concrete cash GP not published in release (null). Q1-17 from 10-Q segment note (thousands); freight-adjusted revenues, freight & other revenues, aggregates tons (38.2m) and cash GP are published only in $ millions/1dp in 10-Q MD&A. agg_price 12.99 = Q1-16 $12.42 + published increase of $0.57/ton (10-Q MD&A); exact price not printed. Asphalt tons/price and concrete cy/price not published in the 10-Q (only % changes: asphalt +5%, concrete +22%) -> null.

is.notes: Pre-2018 presentation: income statement shows only 'Total revenues' (freight & delivery revenues included). is.delivery_rev = 'Freight and delivery revenues' and is.net_sales = 'Total revenues excluding freight and delivery revenues' from the release's non-GAAP gross-margin reconciliation (published figures, not computed). No noncontrolling interest (nci = 0). dps = cash dividends per share as shown in the release/10-Q statement of earnings. Q1-17 from the 10-Q (no earnings release filed). net_sales/delivery_rev from 10-Q MD&A reconciliation in $ millions (669.2 / 118.1).

ngaap.notes: EBITDA (Vulcan definition) excludes discontinued operations: the Net earnings->EBITDA reconciliation adds back income tax (continuing ops), interest expense, net, and '(Earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax' (captured in extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback), then DDA&A. Hence the schema check ni_vulcan + tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub only holds after adding ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback; adj_items.disc_ops is null (not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). ebitda_bridge_lines = EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA lines (zero lines kept as published). NO Q1-17 earnings release (8-K Item 2.02) exists on EDGAR; all Q1-17 data from the Q1-17 10-Q (MD&A non-GAAP reconciliations are in $ millions, 1 dp). Adjusted EPS not published for Q1-17. Implied from Q2-17 release six-month table: 6M adjusted diluted EPS $1.24 - Q2 $0.90 = $0.34 (items in Adj. EBITDA 6M $0.09 - Q2 $0.07 = $0.02) — NOT published, left null. 10-Q discrete items: $15.5m excess tax benefit from share-based comp (ASU 2016-09), not adjusted out. Q1-17 Adjusted EBITDA excludes business-development charges adjustment (definition change in 2017). 10-Q also publishes Asphalt cash GP 14.3, Concrete cash GP 13.5, Calcium cash GP 0.9.
